title: decaloba rohrii
intro: Decaloba rohrii, commonly known as Rohri, is a plant species in the family Malpighiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Decaloba rohrii include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, digestive issues, and skin infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
